question: Mask of the Schemer makes the equipped creature connive X. Do I put the +1/+1 counters on the creature before I draw and discard?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you draw X cards, discard X cards, and then put counters for the nonland cards discarded.
expected.answer: Connive X is a variant of connive. If a creature connives X, its controller will draw X cards, discard X cards, then then put a number of +1/+1 counters on the conniving permanent equal to the number of nonland cards discarded this way.
